create_FLMetricsReporter_subclass: create a subclass of FLMetricsReporter that implements compare_metrics, compute_scores, and create_eval_metrics abstract methods
add_batch_metrics_to_reporter: add batch metrics including loss, predictions, targets, and model inputs to the FLMetricsReporter instance
report_metrics_with_tensorboard: report training or evaluation metrics to stdout and tensorboard using the report_metrics method with a training stage
reset_FLMetricsReporter_state: reset the FLMetricsReporter by clearing all accumulated losses, predictions, targets, and model inputs lists
get_latest_scores_from_reporter: get the latest computed scores dictionary from the FLMetricsReporter after calling report_metrics
